name: The Winter Kiss
source:
Our passionate heroine has just finished her studies in interior design. She moves to New York because she wants to work for Walsh's Design. The best agency in town which was founded by a brilliant and ambitious woman, Sheryl Walsh.

To her surprise, she is summoned for an interview with the agency that so many young graduates dream about. The interview is conducted by the charismatic artistic director, Dan Walsh …Little by little, a duo is formed between the two. Is it love?

Or

Cary Hughes a businessman who is back in town after many years on the West Coast and traveling around the world. Hughes calls on Walsh's Design to renovate his New York penthouse. The heroine spends many moments going between the agency and the Hughes’s penthouse, and, little by little, she becomes acquainted with the mysterious businessman. What is his secret? is it romance? … is it love?

You will find yourself caught in the middle of a love triangle, having to choose between Dan Walsh and Cary Hughes. Make your choices carefully as you might lose the love of your life.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tictales.thewinterkiss&hl=en]Google Store[/url]]
translation:
熱情的女主角剛完成室內設計學業。她搬到紐約，是因為想在沃爾什設計公司工作。這是城裡最好的設計事務所，由聰明而有野心的謝麗爾．沃爾什創辦。

令她驚訝的是，她收到了面試通知；許多年輕畢業生都夢想進入這家事務所。面試由富有魅力的藝術總監丹．沃爾什主持……兩人逐漸組成搭檔。這是愛情嗎？

或者，是多年後從美國西岸歸來、周遊世界的商人凱里．休斯？休斯來到沃爾什設計公司，要求他們翻新自己的紐約頂層公寓。女主角往返於事務所與休斯的頂層公寓之間，逐漸認識這位神秘商人。他隱藏著什麼秘密？這是浪漫嗎？……是愛情嗎？

你會陷入三角戀，在丹．沃爾什與凱里．休斯之間做出選擇。慎重選擇，因為你可能會失去一生摯愛。

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tictales.thewinterkiss&hl=en]Google Play商店[/url]]
